title: ci: add docs-dispatch workflow (composer pings)
body:
## Summary

- Adds `.github/workflows/docs-dispatch.yml`: on a push to `main` that changes `docs/`, `README.md` or `CHANGELOG.md`, it sends a `repository_dispatch` so the docs site at docs.makegov.com rebuilds.
- Matches the workflow the Python and Node SDKs already run: same trigger paths, same dispatch payload, `actions/checkout@v6`.

## Before merging

- [ ] Add the `DOCS_DISPATCH_TOKEN` repository secret (a token with `contents:write` on the docs repository). Without it the dispatch step fails on every docs change.
- [ ] Optionally set the `DOCS_TARGET_REPO` repository variable to override the dispatch target.

~ Mark
